Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by introducing an unnecessary “accepted-genus” criterion and conflating “orchid” with “accepted natural genus.” Laeliocattleya, while a nothogenus (intergeneric orchid hybrid) within Orchidaceae, is still an orchid. This misclassification led to the incorrect conclusion “No” instead of recognizing that both Broughtonia and Laeliocattleya are orchids.
